terms.comment: Also a dead body. Corpus cūrāre is to look after oneself: to eat and rest (Liv. 21.54.2).

phrases.english: a healthy mind in a healthy body

phrases.latin: quod quī sequitur, corpore senex esse poterit, animō numquam erit
phrases.english: whoever follows this may be old in body, but never in mind
now is the time to eat and rest

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 76, 281.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-cicero-philosophica, loci-livius), checked against the editions named there.
